Eat it to recover a bit of health.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Toasty Sunshrooms are a type of [[Roasted Food]], and they can be made by exposing [[Sunshroom]]s to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} It is considered a good idea to keep at least one Toasty Sunshroom on hand for emergencies. They restore three-quarters of a [[Heart]] to [[Link]] when eaten. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Toasty Sunshrooms reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Sunshroom]]s to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Many residents of [[Hyrule]] prefer to keep Toasty Sunshrooms on hand in the event of an emergency. When [[Link]] eats a Toasty Sunshroom, he will heal three-quarters of a [[Heart]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Roasted Food * Sunshroom }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
